aboutGame.title: What is Winds of Viridia?
paragraphs: Winds of Viridia is a single-player action adventure from Shark Jump, set in a handcrafted fantasy valley watched over by the ancient Grantree. You explore on foot and through momentum-driven traversal, fight frenzied beasts, collect relics, and combine Totems to shape how your hero plays.

A free demo is available on PC and Nintendo Switch 2 ahead of the early 2027 launch. The journey blends roll, slide, flip, and grapple movement with real-time combat, a Mothbug companion that assists in exploration and battle, and a Sanctuary hub where residents and shared meals anchor the adventure.

items.question: What is Winds of Viridia?
items.answer: Winds of Viridia is a single-player action adventure from Shark Jump set in a handcrafted fantasy valley. Players explore toward the Grantree, fight frenzied beasts, collect relics, combine Totems, and use fluid movement with a Mothbug companion.

items.question: Is there a Winds of Viridia demo?
items.answer: Yes. A free Winds of Viridia demo is available on PC and Nintendo Switch 2 before the early 2027 launch. It includes movement practice, combat encounters, Totems, and the Mothbug companion.

items.question: Which platforms will Winds of Viridia release on?
items.answer: Winds of Viridia is announced for PC via Steam and Nintendo Switch 2, with an early 2027 release window.

items.question: How does movement work in Winds of Viridia?
items.answer: Winds of Viridia builds traversal around running, rolling, sliding, flipping, and grappling. Chaining those actions opens shortcuts, helps you cross gaps, and keeps you mobile during combat.

items.question: What are Totems in Winds of Viridia?
items.answer: Totems are relics found while exploring Winds of Viridia. Combining them changes your playstyle, letting you lean toward mobility, sustain, burst damage, or utility.

items.question: Who is the Mothbug companion in Winds of Viridia?
items.answer: The Mothbug is a companion in Winds of Viridia that assists with exploration and combat. Keep it active in unfamiliar areas and watch how it supports you during fights.
